declarations.name: ImgAltOverlayElement
declarations.description: A light-DOM image wrapper with a non-modal, in-image alt-text dialog, custom toggle command, native closing command, and JavaScript command fallback. The opener reflects aria-expanded; the default stylesheet reveals the separate Close control on focus.

attributes.name: button-label
attributes.description: Visible and accessible opener label. Must be nonempty.

attributes.name: dialog-label
attributes.description: Dialog heading and accessible dialog name. Visually hidden by the default stylesheet. Must be nonempty.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Dismissal wording for the opener while open and accessible name of the separate icon Close button. Must be nonempty.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Closes any open dialog, restores authored markup, and rereads image structure and labels.

events.name: img-alt-overlay:ready
events.description: Bubbles when a new set of usable controls has been created.

events.name: img-alt-overlay:error
events.description: Bubbles on configuration or setup failure. Authored content remains intact.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-dialog-min-block-size
cssProperties.description: Minimum dialog block size within the available overlay area, with a 4rem control-sized floor when space permits and capped at the area's size. Accepts CSS lengths or percentages and requires a definite overlay block size. For auto-sized, edge-anchored areas, set the dialog's min-block-size directly.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-button-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Logical block-start inset of the independently positioned opener.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-button-inset-block-end
cssProperties.description: Logical block-end inset of the opener. Unset block-start to auto when anchoring here.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-button-inset-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Logical inline-start inset of the opener.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-button-inset-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Logical inline-end inset of the opener.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-overlay-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Logical block-start inset of the overlay area. Default reserves room below the opener.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-overlay-inset-block-end
cssProperties.description: Logical block-end inset of the overlay area.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-overlay-inset-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Logical inline-start inset of the overlay area.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-overlay-inset-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Logical inline-end inset of the overlay area.

cssProperties.name: --img-alt-button-color
cssProperties.description: Opener text color in the optional stylesheet.

declarations.name: defineImgAltOverlay
declarations.description: Registers img-alt-overlay when a browser registry exists; also called on import.
